decisions.reason: As a consumer-facing superfood product outside the firm's main industrial-technology commercialization logic, it likely imposes higher ongoing marketing and channel costs while early website evidence shows only limited commitment.
Modular waste-to-energy extensions fit the core engineering business, can be kept on the market at relatively low option cost, and preserve upside in a growing sustainability market.
The dedicated product page signals stronger commitment and learning potential, and the product sits squarely within the firm's established waste-to-energy capabilities.

Plastic-waste-to-fuel is technically and commercially more uncertain, but because it is close to the firm's core and future circular-economy opportunities remain unresolved, it is still worth keeping as an option for now.
